title: TextEDA IR v0.18 — module view shard
description: The reusable drawing of one module definition: where the module's own symbols sit, how its wires run, where its labels and interface ports are drawn. The drawing has its own bounds and no electrical authority — it names the module's existing instances, nets and ports, and the module file stays their only authority. Lengths are integer nanometers, angles integer millidegrees (ADR-0006). The origin is the drawing's upper-left corner, +x right, +y down. See ADR-0068, ADR-0035, ADR-0067.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard; see teda.md §13.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

module_id.description: The module this drawing draws, e.g. charger-power. Resolved from the file name views/modules/<module_id>.module-view.teda; it must be the module whose definition the drawing refers to.

bounds.description: The extent of this module drawing. The local origin is the upper-left corner of the bounds, +x right and +y down; every drawn point must lie inside them (ADR-0068 D2).

place.description: Where each component instance of the module sits in the drawing, sorted by instance id.

field.description: Optional manual positions for the Reference and Value fields, in symbol-local coordinates; rows are sorted by instance_id then name.

junction.description: Named drawing-graph junctions, sorted by id. Junctions do not create schematic connectivity.

wire.description: Wire polylines, one per drawn run; several wires may belong to the same net.

label.description: Net name labels; the text shown is the net id itself, never an override.

port.description: The drawn symbol of each module port; a port names an existing port of the module, it never creates one.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute (ADR-0005 rule 8).

module_endpoint_ref.description: A module-local pin reference (<refdes>.<pin_number>, e.g. U1.5), a module-local port id (e.g. SYS_OUT), or a declared junction id. Every id resolves against the module definition this drawing belongs to; a module drawing never names a board instance.

place.description: The position and rotation of one component instance of the module.

instance_id.description: The module's own instance id, e.g. U1. Must exist in the module's instances. The drawing names ids, it does not define them; the module instance prefix (M1.) belongs to the board, not to this drawing.

x_nm.description: Symbol origin, x from the drawing's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Symbol origin, y from the drawing's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

rot_mdeg.description: Symbol rotation, clockwise positive, millidegrees; reduced modulo 360000. Omitted means 0.

unit.description: Which unit of a multi-unit symbol to draw. Omitted means unit 1.

field.description: A manual position for one visible symbol field. Coordinates use the symbol's local axes: +x right and +y up. Absence means the renderer chooses the automatic position.

x_nm.description: Field anchor x in symbol-local coordinates, nanometres. +x is right.

y_nm.description: Field anchor y in symbol-local coordinates, nanometres. +y is up.

junction.description: A named view-only node in the module drawing graph.

x_nm.description: Junction position, x from the drawing's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Junction position, y from the drawing's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

wire.description: One polyline of one module net between named pin, port or junction endpoints, optionally bending through given points.

net.description: The module net this wire draws. Pin endpoints must be members of it in the module's nets.

from_pin.description: Start endpoint identity: a module-local pin, a module-local port, or a declared junction.

to_pin.description: End endpoint identity, with the same endpoint kinds as `from_pin`.

points.description: Bend points in the order they are traversed. Omitted means a straight wire.

label.description: A net name shown at a point in the module drawing.

net.description: The module net whose name is shown. The label text is this id; it cannot be overridden.

x_nm.description: Label position, x from the drawing's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Label position, y from the drawing's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

port.description: The drawn symbol of one module port.

id.description: Module port id, e.g. SYS_OUT. The port must be declared by the module this drawing belongs to; the port's name is the module's outward-facing one.

x_nm.description: Port position, x from the drawing's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Port position, y from the drawing's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

rot_mdeg.description: Port rotation, clockwise positive, millidegrees; reduced modulo 360000. Omitted means 0.

text.description: A free-text annotation in the module drawing.

x_nm.description: Text position, x from the drawing's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Text position, y from the drawing's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

point.description: A point in the module drawing's local coordinates.

x_nm.description: x from the drawing's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: y from the drawing's upper-left corner, increasing downward.
